monthlyTasks.en: Deep clean range hood and built-in hob
monthlyTasks.fil: Malalim na linis ng range hood at built-in hob

description.en: Do not borrow money from anyone — employers, neighbours, or other helpers. If you need something, please ask the employer directly.
description.fil: Huwag humiram ng pera mula sa sinuman — employer, kapitbahay, o ibang katulong. Kung may kailangan ka, diretso mong tanungin ang employer.

consequences.en: First offence: serious written warning and meeting with employer. Any hidden borrowing or repeat offence: contract terminated immediately, repatriation arranged, and employer may report to the agency.
consequences.fil: Unang paglabag: seryosong written warning at meeting sa employer. Anumang naitagong paghiram o ulit na paglabag: tatapusin agad ang kontrata, repatriation, at maaaring i-report ng employer sa agency.
consequences.zh: 第一次：嚴正書面警告及與僱主會面。任何隱瞞借錢或再犯：立即終止合約、安排遣返，僱主可向中介報告。

description.en: Zizi (our son) is the top priority. His meals, nap time, homework, and safety come before other household tasks. If Zizi needs attention, stop other work and help him first.
description.fil: Si Zizi (ang anak namin) ang unang prayoridad. Ang pagkain, tulog, takdang-aralin, at kaligtasan niya ay mas mahalaga kaysa ibang gawaing bahay. Kung kailangan ni Zizi ng tulong, itigil muna ang iba at unahin siya.

consequences.en: If Zizi is left hungry, unsafe, or unattended because other tasks were prioritised: written warning. Serious neglect or repeat: employment terminated — Zizi's safety is non-negotiable.
consequences.fil: Kung si Zizi ay gutom, delikado, o walang nagbabantay dahil inuna ang ibang gawain: written warning. Malubhang pagpapabaya o ulit: tatapusin ang trabaho — hindi pwedeng i-kompromiso ang kaligtasan ni Zizi.
consequences.zh: 若因先做其他工作而令 Zizi 餓肚、不安全或無人看管：書面警告。嚴重疏忽或再犯：終止僱傭 — Zizi 的安全絕不可妥協。

title.fil: Hiwalay na Gamit para sa Hilaw at Lutong Karne

description.en: Always use separate chopping boards and knives for raw (fresh) meat and cooked meat. Never mix them. Wash hands and tools after handling raw meat.
description.fil: Laging gumamit ng hiwalay na chopping board at kutsilyo para sa hilaw (sariwang) karne at lutong karne. Huwag pagsamahin. Maghugas ng kamay at gamit pagkatapos humawak ng hilaw na karne.

consequences.en: Mixing raw and cooked tools can make the family sick. First time: retraining and written warning. If anyone gets ill or it happens again: employment terminated.
consequences.fil: Ang paghalu ng gamit para sa hilaw at luto ay maaaring magkasakit ang pamilya. Unang beses: retraining at written warning. Kung may magkasakit o maulit: tatapusin ang trabaho.
consequences.zh: 混用生熟用具可令家人病。第一次：重新訓練及書面警告。若有人病或再犯：終止僱傭。

title.fil: Lagyan ng Label ang Chopping Board

description.en: Red board & knife = raw meat only. Green board & knife = cooked food / vegetables. Blue board = fish only. Clean and dry after each use.
description.fil: Pula na board at kutsilyo = hilaw na karne lang. Berde na board at kutsilyo = lutong pagkain / gulay. Asul na board = isda lang. Linisin at patuyuin pagkatapos gamitin.

consequences.en: Using the wrong board risks food poisoning. First time: written warning and supervised retraining. Repeat or if family falls ill: employment terminated.
consequences.fil: Maling board ay delikado sa pagkain. Unang beses: written warning at supervised retraining. Ulit o kung may magkasakit sa pamilya: tatapusin ang trabaho.
consequences.zh: 用錯砧板可導致食物中毒。第一次：書面警告及在監督下重新訓練。再犯或家人病：終止僱傭。

description.en: You have a rest break every day as agreed. Please finish urgent tasks for Zizi before resting.
description.fil: May oras ka ng pahinga araw-araw ayon sa kasunduan. Tapusin muna ang mga urgent na gawain para kay Zizi bago magpahinga.

consequences.en: Resting before finishing Zizi's urgent needs (meals, pickup, safety): verbal then written warning. Repeated: rest time reduced and contract reviewed; may lead to termination.
consequences.fil: Magpahinga bago tapusin ang urgent na gawain kay Zizi (pagkain, sundo, kaligtasan): verbal tapos written warning. Paulit-ulit: bawasan ang rest time at review ng kontrata; maaaring matapos ang trabaho.
consequences.zh: 未完成 Zizi 緊急需要（膳食、接送、安全）就休息：口頭繼而書面警告。再犯：縮短休息時間及檢討合約；可能終止僱傭。

title.en: Keep Phone for Emergencies During Work
title.fil: Telepono para sa Emergency Lang Habang Nagtatrabaho

description.en: Personal phone use should be during rest time only. Keep phone nearby for emergencies and employer contact.
description.fil: Ang personal na telepono ay sa oras ng pahinga lang. Ilagay malapit ang telepono para sa emergency at contact ng employer.

consequences.en: Personal phone use during work (not rest time): verbal warning. Repeated or phone use while caring for Zizi: written warning, then termination if it continues.
consequences.fil: Personal na telepono habang nagtatrabaho (hindi rest time): verbal warning. Paulit-ulit o gamit habang inaalagaan si Zizi: written warning, tapos termination kung magpatuloy.
consequences.zh: 工作時間（非休息時間）使用私人手機：口頭警告。再犯或照顧 Zizi 時使用：書面警告，仍繼續則終止僱傭。

description.en: If something breaks, if Zizi is unwell, or if you are unsure about anything — tell the employer right away. Do not wait.
description.fil: Kung may masira, kung may sakit si Zizi, o kung may hindi ka sigurado — sabihin agad sa employer. Huwag maghintay.

consequences.en: Not reporting a problem in time — especially if Zizi is hurt, something breaks, or food/kitchen is unsafe — helper is held responsible for resulting harm. Serious cases: written warning or termination.
consequences.fil: Hindi agad na i-report ang problema — lalo na kung nasaktan si Zizi, may nasira, o delikado ang pagkain/kusina — pananagutan ng helper ang resulta. Malubhang kaso: written warning o termination.
consequences.zh: 不及時報告問題 — 尤其 Zizi 受傷、物品損壞或廚房不安全 — 助理須對後果負責。嚴重：書面警告或終止僱傭。

description.en: Always lock the main door when leaving or at night. Check windows before sleeping.
description.fil: Laging i-lock ang pangunahing pinto kapag aalis o sa gabi. Suriin ang mga bintana bago matulog.

consequences.en: Leaving doors or windows unlocked: written warning. If theft, break-in, or Zizi could have been harmed results: employment terminated and helper may be held responsible.
consequences.fil: Hindi na-lock ang pinto o bintana: written warning. Kung may nakawan, break-in, o si Zizi ay naging delikado: tatapusin ang trabaho at maaaring managot ang helper.
consequences.zh: 門窗未上鎖：書面警告。若導致盜竊、入屋或 Zizi 可能受傷：終止僱傭，助理可能須負責。
